system.description:
Drawing up the buried roots of turmoil and despair, the Daughter of Cacophony awakens madness from within the soul. Like the fabled songs of mermaids and faerie singers, her melody drives a chosen listener down into desperation and unreason.

Make a Social Challenge (retest Performance) against your target as you sing. If you win, the victim is struck with one randomly chosen derangement lasting the rest of the night. You may draw the derangement at random from a stack of cards, or tie it to the song you sang — regression for a children's tune, megalomania for a national anthem. The affliction endures until the next dawn.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
